fact: The ministry reports that on a surprise tour of six schools in Giza and Cairo the minister, Mohamed Abdel Latif, checked attendance and absence registers (دفاتر الحضور والغياب), the registers recording pupils' marks in the weekly assessments and the year's-work mark register at primary and preparatory schools, among them the Othman Ibn Affan and El Sahel primary schools; the text names registers (دفاتر) and no digital system, and does not say the records are on paper only. The page carries no date in its text; the lead's date of 24 November 2024 is used.
title: وزير التربية والتعليم يتابع انتظام العملية التعليمية خلال جولة مفاجئة في عدد من مدارس محافظتي الجيزة والقاهرة
